OWNER.label: Owner
OWNER.description: Runs the organization and works with patients.

ADMIN.label: Manager
ADMIN.description: Manages members and settings. No access to patient records.

PRACTITIONER.label: Practitioner
PRACTITIONER.description: Sees and records the organization's patients.

clinicalOwnerOnly: Only an owner can give access to patient records.

header.mfaBody: Every member of a medical organization must use 2-step sign-in before working in it.

switcher.label: Organization
switcher.hint: You belong to several organizations. Choose the one to work in.

none.title: Work together with your clinic
none.description: Clinics, hospitals and private practices share patient records securely among their practitioners. There are two ways to start.
none.disabledBody: The owner or a manager turned off your access to these organizations. Contact them if this is a mistake:
none.joinDescription: If your clinic already uses Bio-Dosha-12.
none.joinStep1Body: Ask your clinic's owner or manager to send an invitation to {email}.
none.joinStep2Body: Open the invitation link while signed in to this account. You join right away.
none.joinStep3Body: Members of medical organizations must use it. Setup takes about two minutes.
none.registerDescription: You become its owner and can invite colleagues. The platform team verifies the details before patient records open.
none.verifyNote: After you register, the platform team checks these details. Until then you can set up the organization and invite colleagues, but patient records stay closed.
none.registered: Organization registered. It is waiting for verification.
none.doneDescription: {name} is waiting for verification by the platform team.
none.doneStep1Body: Required for every member of a medical organization. You need a phone with an authenticator app.
none.doneStep2Body: Add practitioners and managers from the organization page.
none.doneStep3Body: Once the platform team verifies your organization, owners and practitioners can open patient records.

form.name: Organization name
form.nameHint: The official name. It appears on reports and invitations.
form.nameRequired: Please enter the organization name (at least 2 characters).
form.registrationNumberHint: The organization's state registration number, not a personal ID.
form.emailHint: A shared address such as info@… (optional).
form.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.

overview.activeBody: Verified on {date}. All features are available.
overview.suspendedSince: The platform team suspended this organization on {date}.
overview.suspendedNoDate: The platform team suspended this organization.
overview.suspendedContact: Patient records and management are closed. Please contact the system administrator.
overview.pendingBody: The platform team is checking your registration details. Patient records open once the organization is verified.
overview.next1Body: Keep the name and registration number correct under Settings.
overview.next2Body: Set up 2-step sign-in and invite your colleagues.
overview.next3Body: Your practitioners can then open and keep patient records.
overview.practitionersHint: Owners and practitioners count toward this limit. Managers don't.
overview.changePlan: Contact us to change your plan.

members.title: Members
members.caption: Organization members
members.name: Name
members.readOnlyNote: Only owners and managers can change members.
members.lastOwnerNote: You are the only owner, so you can't leave. First make another member an owner.
members.twoStepPending: {count, plural, one {# member hasn't set up 2-step sign-in yet and can't work in the organization until they do.} other {# members haven't set up 2-step sign-in yet and can't work in the organization until they do.}}
members.suspendedBody: Member changes are paused while the organization is suspended. Please contact the system administrator.
members.disableBody: They will no longer be able to open this organization or its patient records. Records they entered stay. You can turn access back on later.
members.removeBody: They lose access immediately. Patient records they entered stay with the organization. To bring them back, send a new invitation.
members.leaveBody: You will lose access to this organization and its patient records. To come back you will need a new invitation.

manage.title: Manage {name}
manage.selfDescription: You can change your job title. Only another owner or manager can change your role or access.
manage.selfRoleNote: Nobody can change their own role.
manage.ownerRoleNote: Only an owner can change another owner's role or access.
manage.toManager: {name} will no longer see patient records.
manage.toClinical: {name} will see all of the organization's patients. This counts toward your plan's practitioner limit.
manage.toOwner: {name} will also manage members and settings, including other owners.
manage.fromOwner: {name} will keep working with patients but will no longer manage the organization.
manage.noSeatBody: {limit, plural, one {Your plan includes # practitioner, and that place is taken.} other {Your plan includes # practitioners, and all places are taken.}} Turn off another practitioner's access, or contact us to upgrade.
manage.jobTitleHint: Shown to colleagues, for example "Head physician".
manage.disableHint: Turning access off keeps the person's records, and you can turn it back on later.
manage.enableHint: They can work in the organization again right away.
manage.enableNoSeat: Your plan's practitioner limit is reached, so access can't be turned back on.
manage.leaveHint: You will lose access to this organization and its patient records.
manage.lastOwnerNote: You are the only owner, so you can't leave. First make another member an owner.
manage.ownerAccessNote: Only an owner can turn off or remove another owner.

invites.formDescription: We create a one-time link. The person opens it, creates an account or signs in with this email, and joins your organization.
invites.pendingNote: Your organization is waiting for verification. Colleagues can join now, but invitations are not emailed yet: you get a link to send yourself. Patient records open after verification.
invites.emailHint: The email the person will sign in with.
invites.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
invites.managerHint: To add an owner or a practitioner, ask an owner of your organization to send the invitation.
invites.seatsNote: Owners and practitioners count toward your plan's practitioner limit: {used} of {limit} in use. Managers don't count.
invites.noSeatBody: To invite another owner or practitioner, turn off someone's access or contact us to upgrade your plan. You can still invite a manager.
invites.emailSent: We also emailed the link to this address.
invites.emailPending: Invitations are not emailed while your organization is waiting for verification. Please send the link yourself.
invites.emailFailed: We couldn't send the email. Please send the link yourself.
invites.emailOff: Email sending is not set up, so please send the link yourself.
invites.linkNote: Shown only once. Valid until {date}. Copy it now.
invites.next1Title: Send the link through a trusted channel
invites.next1Body: For example in person, by phone or in a work messenger. Anyone who has the link can use it.
invites.next2Title: The person signs up or signs in
invites.next2Body: They open the link and create their account, or sign in, with {email}.
invites.next3Body: Every member must do this before working in the organization.
invites.listDescription: To resend, create a new invitation for the same email. The old link stops working automatically.
invites.revokeBody: The link sent to {email} stops working immediately. You can send a new invitation later.
invites.empty: No invitations yet. Invite a colleague with the form above.
invites.suspendedBody: The organization is suspended, so new invitations can't be sent. You can still revoke pending ones.

settings.title: Organization profile
settings.description: Keep these details accurate: the platform team uses them to verify the organization.
settings.visibilityNote: Changes are visible to the platform team. The name appears on reports and invitations.
settings.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
settings.readOnlyNote: Only owners and managers can change these details.
settings.suspendedNote: Changes are paused while the organization is suspended. Please contact the system administrator.
